# MuGate

> University AI platform that guides students to academic excellence at the Lebanese University.

MuGate helps students with chatbot Q&A, course scheduling, internships, resume tools, capstone planning, events, and degree roadmaps.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://mugate.org/): Landing page and sign-in.
- [Chatbot](https://mugate.org/chatbot): AI assistant for university and academic questions.
- [Schedule](https://mugate.org/schedule): Build and manage course schedules.
- [Internships](https://mugate.org/internships): Browse and explore internship opportunities.
- [Resume enhancer](https://mugate.org/resume-enhancer): Create and improve student resumes.
- [Capstone](https://mugate.org/capstone): Capstone project ideas, partners, and guidance.
- [Events](https://mugate.org/events): University events and announcements.
- [Roadmap](https://mugate.org/roadmap): Degree and course progression planning.
- [About](https://mugate.org/about): Project overview and team information.
- [Download](https://mugate.org/download): MuGate mobile app download.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://mugate.org/sitemap.xml): Full list of public URLs for crawlers.
